description: Source code for a multiprocessing API in torch.distributed.elastic, defining classes and functions for process management, signal handling, logging, and process coordination.

classes.name: SignalException
classes.description: Exception raised inside the torchelastic agent process when a death signal is received.

classes.name: Std
classes.description: Enum for stream redirection options, with methods for parsing from string.

classes.name: LogsDest
classes.description: Holds mappings of local rank IDs to log file paths for stdout, stderr, and error files.

classes.name: LogsSpecs
classes.description: Abstract base class defining log processing and redirection strategies.

classes.name: DefaultLogsSpecs
classes.description: Default implementation of LogsSpecs, creating log directories and paths based on environment.

classes.name: RunProcsResult
classes.description: Results of a process run, including return values, failures, and log paths.

classes.name: PContext
classes.description: Abstract base class for managing a set of processes, including start, poll, wait, and close operations.

classes.name: MultiprocessContext
classes.description: Concrete implementation of PContext managing processes invoked as functions.

classes.name: SubprocessContext
classes.description: Concrete implementation of PContext managing subprocesses invoked as binaries.

methods.name: SignalException
methods.description: Constructor for SignalException, storing message and signal value.

methods.name: _terminate_process_handler
methods.description: Handles termination signals, raising SignalException.

methods.name: _get_kill_signal
methods.description: Returns platform-specific kill signal.

methods.name: _get_default_signal
methods.description: Returns platform-specific default termination signal.

methods.name: _validate_full_rank
methods.description: Validates that a rank-to-value mapping covers all expected ranks.

methods.name: Std.from_str
methods.description: Parses a string into a Std enum or mapping.

methods.name: to_map
methods.description: Converts a Std or dict into a rank-to-Std mapping.

methods.name: LogsSpecs.reify
methods.description: Builds log destination paths based on environment variables.

methods.name: PContext.start
methods.description: Starts the managed processes.

methods.name: PContext.wait
methods.description: Waits for processes to complete or timeout.

methods.name: PContext.pids
methods.description: Returns a mapping of local ranks to process IDs.

methods.name: PContext._close
methods.description: Terminates all processes and cleans up resources.

methods.name: MultiprocessContext._start
methods.description: Starts processes as mp processes.

methods.name: MultiprocessContext._poll
methods.description: Polls process status, returns results or failure info.

methods.name: MultiprocessContext.pids
methods.description: Returns process IDs for all managed processes.

methods.name: MultiprocessContext._close
methods.description: Terminates mp processes.

methods.name: SubprocessContext._start
methods.description: Starts subprocesses via get_subprocess_handler.

methods.name: SubprocessContext._poll
methods.description: Polls subprocesses, returns results or failures.

methods.name: SubprocessContext.pids
methods.description: Returns process IDs of subprocesses.

methods.name: SubprocessContext._close
methods.description: Terminates subprocesses.
